## Byte Data Types
| Byte | Value Type | Description | Example | Length |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | 
| 0x00 | Null | It represents null values | 0x00 | 1 |
| 0x01 | False | Represents the 'false' Boolean Value | 0x01 | 1 |
| 0x02 | True | Represents the 'true' Boolean Value | 0x02 | 1 |
| 0x03 | Byte | Represents an integer between 0 and 255 | [0x03, 0xFF] - Represents 255 | 2 |
| 0x04 | Uint32 | Represents a 32 Bits Integer | [0x04, 0x7F, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF] - Represents 2_147_483_647 | 5 |
| 0x05 | Uint64 | Represents a 64 Bits Integer | [0x05, 0x0D, 0xE0, 0xB6, 0xB3, 0xA7, 0x64, 0x00, 0x00] - Represents 10¹⁸ (1_000_000_000_000_000_000) | 9 |
| 0x06 | Float | Represents a 32 Bits floating number with IEEE 754 Specification | [0x06, 0x40, 0x49, 0x0F, 0xDB] - Represents 3.141592 | 5 |
| 0x07 | Double | Represents a 64 Bits floating number with IEEE 754 Specification, known as Double | [0x07, 0x3F, 0xBF, 0x9A, 0xDD, 0x37, 0x39, 0x63, 0x5F] - Represents 0.12345678 | 9 |
| 0x08 | Char | Represents a Latin1 Character Code Point | [0x08, 0x41] - Represents **A** in Latin1 | 2 |
| 0x09 | Small String | Represents a Latin1 string with length varying from 0 to 255, with only 1 byte representing length | [0x09, 0x03, 0x48, 0x69, 0x21] - Represents **Hi!** as a Latin1 Small String | 2..257 |
| 0x0A | String | Represents a Latin1 string with length varying from 0 to 65535, using 2 bytes for the length | [0x0A, 0x00, 0x0C, 0x48, 0x65, 0x6c, 0x6c, 0x6f, 0x20, 0x57, 0x6f, 0x72, 0x6c, 0x64, 0x21] - Represents **Hello World!** in a Regular String | 3..65538 |
| 0x0B | Big String | Represents a Latin1 string with length varying from 0 to 4294967295, using 4 bytes for the length | [0x0B, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x0C, 0x48, 0x65, 0x6c, 0x6c, 0x6f, 0x20, 0x57, 0x6f, 0x72, 0x6c, 0x64, 0x21] - Represents **Hello World!** in a Big String | 5..4294967300 |
| 0x0C | Vector2 | Represents a Vector2 of values, with the numeric data type represented in the next byte | [0x0C, 0x03, 0xFF, 0x7F] - Represents a Byte Vector2 with values [255, 127] | 4..18 |
| 0x0D | Vector3 | Represents a Vector3 of values, with the numeric data type represented in the next byte | [0x0D, 0x06, 0x41, 0x44, 0xC4, 0x9C, 0x42, 0x9D, 0x00, 0x00, 0x43, 0x19, 0x6E, 0x14] - Represents a Float Vector3 with values [12.298f, 78.50f, 153.43f], usefull for 3D coordinates | 5..26 |
| 0x0E | Vector4 | Represents a Vector4 of values, with the numeric data type represented in the next byte | [0x0E, 0x03, 0xFF, 0x7F, 0x00, 0xFF] - Represents a Byte Vector4 with values [255, 127, 0, 255], with color representation of #FF7F00FF, a bright orange, usefull for colors | 6..34 |
| 0x0F | Uint8Array | Represents a array of bytes, with the next 4 bytes being the length | [0x0F, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x05, 0x01, 0x02, 0x03, 0x04, 0x05] - Represents a Array of byte values with values [1, 2, 3, 4, 5] | 5..4294967300 |
